description: Generates a PDF of a single Observation Item and returns a time-limited download URL. This also records a "PDF shared" entry in the Observation's change history, so treat it as an action rather than a cacheable read.

id.description: ID of the Observation Item the PDF was generated for.

url.description: Deprecated — not returned by this endpoint. Use `pdf_url`.

pdf_url.description: Time-limited URL for downloading the generated PDF. Requesting this endpoint also records a "PDF shared" entry in the Observation's change history, so treat it as an action rather than a cacheable ...
